run_FairseqGenerateModule: run a FairseqGenerateModule to translate a source text file from one language to another using a Fairseq model
translate_with_FairseqGenerator: translate an iterable of sentences using FairseqGenerator.translate with batched inference and caching
inference_FairseqGenerator: run batched inference on a list of sentences using FairseqGenerator.inference with optional sentence split and merge
configure_BeamSearchConfig: configure beam search parameters like beam size, length penalty, temperature, and sampling for Fairseq translation
configure_FairseqGeneratorConfig: configure a FairseqGeneratorConfig with model path, source and target languages, GPU settings, and batch size
